ledger_rows: Calibrate uncertainty / abstention when capability is not identifiable.
scope: two disjoint raw task families with different absolute requirement/capacity scales, exhaustively evaluated on the margin grid {-2,0,2}^5 using the already-fitted development-only predictor
assumptions: the registered signed margins remain sufficient for the four exact capability predicates across both task families
task-family differences change raw requirement/capacity scales but not the semantics of the registered capability contracts
CANNOT_IDENTIFY is evaluated as abstention rather than an error or success
this is deterministic selective-prediction calibration, not probabilistic confidence calibration
strongest_parent: domain adaptation under invariant sufficient statistics; selective classification with abstention
negative_twin: if a new task family changes the capability semantics rather than only the raw scale, signed-margin sufficiency need not transfer and this result does not apply
nearest_counterexample: a hidden family-specific interaction can make identical margins imply different outcomes, invalidating transfer
falsifier: Any determinate transfer prediction disagrees with the exact oracle, the two family audits disagree despite matched margins, or an abstention is counted as correct.
